description:
UI/UX design is one of the most in-demand skills of 2024.
There are so many design projects out there on Dribbble and Behance, but only some of them might actually be usable in practice, but why?

Because only some of them adhere to the core fundamentals of UI/UX design.

In this video, I'll be discussing 12 UI/UX laws & principles every designer must know about! These laws and principles are applied in every app or website we see, and knowing these will surely help you create better designs and stand out from the crowd! I've also discussed each law with practical, real-life UI Examples too, so don't forget to watch this till the end!

And Don't forget to subscribe for more such content!

😃 ABOUT ME

This is Saptarshi (a.k.a. Sapta), an engineer turned self-taught Product Designer based out of Bangalore, India. I have worked with some of the very well known startups of India and learned anything and everything that is needed to create amazing experiences for the users. I'm also an active speaker, teacher and community builder, and have delivered over 60 talks, workshops and webinars on design. In this channel, I post videos with tips, strategies, tutorials and general gyaan to scale your career in Design. If you are into it, you may want to subscribe and hit the bell icon to that you don't miss out :)
